title: SBI Club Vistara Prime credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A premium Club Vistara Prime variant offering elevated CV Points, upgrade vouchers, and lounge access for frequent Vistara travelers.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: Insurance cover for upto 6 flight ticket cancelations per year (each limited to 3,500), air accident cover upto 1 crore, and insurance of upto 72000 for loss of check-in baggage, 7,500 if the baggage is delayed, 5000 if the baggage is damaged, and a cover of 12,500 in case you lose your baggage during air travel.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To claim this insurance, immediately report the incident to SBI Customer Care at 1800 1234, 1800 2100, or 1800 112211. For email support, contact customercare@sbi.co.in
